reason: An orchestration extension for DeepSeek Harness that manages MCP server connections and exposes tools, while also providing web-based management of skills, commands, memory, and prompts.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体编排扩展，用于管理 MCP 服务器及其工具，并通过 Web 管理台维护技能、命令、记忆和提示词。
summaries.en: An orchestration extension for DeepSeek Harness that manages MCP servers and their tools through a web console, alongside skills, commands, memory, and prompt management.

capabilities: Connects to MCP servers over stdio, Streamable HTTP, and SSE
Exposes discovered MCP tools to the model
Reads and writes global and project memory files
Creates, edits, and deletes skill bundles
Defines user and project slash commands
Manages prompt sections and persona content
Serves a local web management console and JSON API
